Frequently asked questions

Can you evaluate a product not yet released?

Yes, from reactions to a beta, a teaser or competing products already on the market.

How many reviews does it take?

A few hundred are often enough to see patterns; we tell you if the volume is too low.

Do you cover reviews abroad?

Yes, in more than twenty languages.
